note: The High `dtolnay/rust-toolchain` paths and the scheduled `rustsec/audit-check@master` path (checks and issues write) were judged overstated: a mutable third-party action in a CI job with no secret and no write token (or only an assumed one) gives code execution on a runner, Medium at most.

ceilings.pending: the spec counts any write scope of the token as a write token, while the assessment argued that a token scoped to issues, pull requests or checks only, in a job with no secret, is a Medium at most.
